run: Mimo T04 skill application before refinement
method: Same-session application of the installed skill; not an independent model evaluation or product test
prompt: Use testable-user-stories to write one specification for Mimo T04 Approve a checked lesson. Teacher map stage Lesson preparation, activity Approve the lesson, feature Lesson approval. Original story: As a teacher, I want to review and approve a lesson version so that it meets my standards and unreviewed drafts remain unshared. Source: FigJam nodes 589:3865 and 602:4039. Sources say changed or unreviewed drafts cannot be shared as approved. Keep AI optional. Separate confirmed planning rules from proposals. Provide business rules, criteria, Gherkin tests, edge cases and INVEST.

output.title: Approve a checked lesson
output.story: As a Mimo teacher, I want to review and approve a prepared lesson so that only material I have checked becomes approved.
output.context: Lesson preparation -> Approve the lesson -> Lesson approval. Approval is separate from sharing and must work without AI.
rules: TBR-01 [Source-backed proposal] A teacher explicitly reviews and approves a lesson version.
TBR-02 [Source-backed proposal] Changed or unreviewed drafts cannot be shared as approved.
TBR-03 [Source-backed proposal] Teachers access only authorized lessons; AI assistance remains optional.
criteria: TAC-01 The teacher can open a preview showing the lesson title, intended outcome and activities.
TAC-02 Approving a reviewed draft changes its status to Approved without sharing it.
TAC-03 Changing approved content returns the lesson to Draft and requires review again.
TAC-04 An unrelated teacher cannot approve the lesson.
output.gherkin:
Feature: Approve a checked Mimo lesson
  @TAC01 @TAC02
  Scenario: Approve a reviewed lesson
    Given Gilbert can access draft lesson D1
    And he has reviewed its title, outcome and activities
    When he approves D1
    Then D1 is marked Approved
    And D1 has not been shared

  @TAC03
  Scenario: Edit approved content
    Given D1 is Approved
    When Gilbert changes one activity
    Then D1 returns to Draft
    And review is required again

  @TAC04
  Scenario: Deny an unrelated teacher
    Given teacher X has no access to D1
    When X requests approval of D1
    Then approval is denied
    And D1 is unchanged
edge_questions: What makes a lesson ready for approval? The board does not define mandatory fields.
What happens if approval cannot be saved?
Can another editor change a lesson while Gilbert reviews it?
output.invest: Independent user outcome but dependent on prepared content and access. Negotiable preview UI. Valuable teacher control. Estimation and sprint size need team discussion. Tests cover the listed criteria, with unresolved edge behavior.

works: Approval is explicit and sharing is separate.
weaknesses: TAC-02 and the success test do not identify the reviewed revision; a stale review could approve unseen content.
The no-review path is implied by a rule but has no explicit rejection criterion/test.
The output asks about approval-save failure but gives no specified result or acknowledgement boundary.
The manual path is stated in context without an explicit AI-unavailable acceptance example.
evaluation.refinement: Require lifecycle review for state-changing stories: named revision, state-before/action/state-after, stale or absent review, acknowledgement failure and relevant optional-service fallback. Label newly proposed mechanics.
